data.action: 独坐工作台，一手抓桌沿、一手指交自抚
data.camera: first-person pov, cowboy shot, vertical framing
data.description: 【成年后藤一里 · 私人排练室的女仆装失控】成年一里独自坐在工作台上，女仆围裙卷至腰间，一手抓桌沿、一手在腿间指交自抚，粉发与泪眼映着夕光。
data.lighting: 黄昏暖橘色夕阳穿透窗帘的斜射光
data.location: 文化祭后的空私人工作室角落
data.promptProse: She sits on the worktable in a post-graduation rehearsal studio with her frilled apron gathered at the waist, holding the edge with one hand and touching herself with the other. Warm orange sunset light slants through the curtains.
data.title: 后藤一里 · 女仆装后的特别奉仕
data.animaCaption: Her frilled apron gathers at the waist as one hand grips the worktable edge.
